summary:
R2's the story to build around today: 74% at +19.0u over the last 7 days (n=42), and its bullpen category is running hot at 56% over the last 14 (105-83), which lines up directly with the LAD, SDP and BAL spots on tonight's board where bullpen edges are baked into the consensus number. All four raters stack hardest on PIT @ LAD, with R2 leading the pack at +2.06 — that's the top play of the night, and it sits inside LAD's 21-9 (70%) profile as a liked team, with a stellar 15-2 strong-play record worth +18.0u. Trust that one fully. CLE @ COL is the mirror image, a full four-model pile-on the other way (R2 -2.06, R3 -1.83) fading Cleveland on the road against Sugano — with trends sitting at 57% last 14 days (107-81, n=188) league-wide, a category that fires on nearly every game tonight, this fade carries extra weight.

Where it gets thin: ATL @ MIL is split, R1/R2 leaning Atlanta while R3/R4 flip to Milwaukee at +0.67 and +1.20 — given MIL's strong 68% record (17-8, +8.0u) when the model backs them, side with the R3/R4 read here rather than the shakier road lean. NYM @ CHW is essentially a coin-flip split (R3 alone on NYM at -0.24 against three chalk votes for CHW), too thin a delta to bet with confidence. Elsewhere, DET @ KCR, MIN @ SDP, and WSN @ MIA all show clean four-way agreement in the 1.0-1.8 range — solid complementary plays, especially SDP given the trends+bullpen combo (56.3%, 229-178) underpinning most of tonight's board. Watch bullpen_fatigue across every rating: it's mired in a 3-game losing streak and sitting at 47% both recently and on the season — steer clear of any pick where that's the primary driver, particularly in the ATH @ HOU spot where HOU's strong-play record is bleeding at 27% (-8.0u).
